purpose: Plan 9 rc compatibility matrix for Star 9

crate_boundary.rule: The reusable rc crate has no dependency on Star 9 runtime, web, CLI, or browser glue.

features.notes: Typed AST covers simple commands, assignments, blocks, functions, if/for/while/switch, pipelines, boolean operators, redirection, and command substitution words.
Supports list assignments, empty lists, positional args, $name, $#name, $"name, subscripts, rc apostrophe quoting, doubled apostrophes, and caret concatenation.
Implements *, ?, character classes, complemented classes, ranges, unmatched literal preservation, and the ~ builtin over host filesystem listings.
Supports sequencing, &&, ||, !, background status, if, for, while, switch, functions, and rc-style status strings including all-zero pipeline success.

Basic <, >, >>, << text, and stdout pipelines are implemented. Full Plan 9 fd graph behavior such as process substitution <{}/>{}, all fd dup cases, and exact concurrent pipeline execution remain future-depth work.
Backquote braced command substitution runs through the evaluator and splits output with ifs.
Variables and local command assignments are implemented in the reusable evaluator. Plan 9 environment files and note hooks are adapter-level future-depth work.

Implements core builtins including ., cd, echo, eval, exit, shift, status, wait, whatis, ~, true, false, plus host-limited rfork/flag/builtin placeholders. Exact 9front rendering and rfork semantics remain future-depth work.

External command execution is a host-trait operation. Star 9 adapter delegates to the existing Star 9 shell command surface. Full executable $path search over mounted command namespaces remains future-depth work.
Native `star9 rc`, `star9 shell --rc`, wasm `createRcShell`, and `<star9-shell rc>` are wired.
Optional STAR9_RC_ORACLE comparison runs only when configured and compares portable stdout, stderr, and status cases against plan9port or 9front rc.
